t: Ideal for sealing and filling interior connection joints, seams and cracks, with flexibility and adhesion to provide a tough elastic rubber seal. Adheres without a primer on building materials such as concrete, brickwork and painted wood and is instantly paintable after application with water-based and synthetic-based paints. Remains permanently flexible, effective where movement can occur such as skirting boards, ceilings, architraves, plasterwork and window and door frames. Developed for the professional user.
b: Adheres Without Primer on Building Materials
